nameEn: Manufacture of other non-metallic mineral products n.e.c.
description: This class includes the manufacture of a variety of non-metallic mineral products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of friction material and unmounted articles thereof: brake linings, brake pads, clutch facings
manufacture of mineral insulating materials: slag wool, rock wool, similar mineral wools
manufacture of articles of asphalt or similar materials: asphalt-based adhesives, coaltar pitch, asphalt felt
manufacture of articles of bitumen: bituminous roofing felt, bitumen-based paints
manufacture of graphite and other non-metallic mineral products
manufacture of articles of pumice stone
excludes: manufacture of refractory ceramic products, see 2391
manufacture of ceramic building materials, see 2392
